reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: Why has Anna rented a car?
options: To drive around and see more of the city.
To take her first driving lesson.
answers: To drive around and see more of the city.
questions.evidence: Today, I rented a car so I can drive around Washington, D.C. You can see more of the city this way.
questions.explanation: so I can说明租车目的，是开车游览华盛顿、看到更多城市景色。Anna已经通过驾照考试，不是在租车开始第一次学车；她会开农场设备是过去经验，不是这次租车运货的用途。

spokenEvidence.quote: Today, I rented a car so I can drive around Washington, D.C. You can see more of the city this way.

questions.prompt: On which attempt did Anna pass her driving test?
questions.evidence: But I did pass the second time .
questions.explanation: Marsha问她是否第一次就通过，Anna先否认，再明确说the second time。因此选第二次。后文还说她练习后第二次通过，形成相互核对的依据；不要只听到“通过了”就省略次数。

spokenEvidence.quote: But I did pass the second time .

questions.prompt: What makes Anna nervous about driving in Washington, D.C.?
options: Having no driving experience of any kind.
questions.evidence: I can drive farm equipment really well. But I was really nervous driving in Washington, D.C. traffic!
questions.explanation: but前说她农场设备开得很好，后说在城市交通中驾驶很紧张，对比表明问题是D.C. traffic。不能选完全没有驾驶经验，也不能把她熟悉的农场设备当作紧张原因。

spokenEvidence.quote: I can drive farm equipment really well. But I was really nervous driving in Washington, D.C. traffic!

questions.prompt: What does John say Anna should have done before turning?
options: Looked for cars in the street.
answers: Looked for cars in the street.
questions.evidence: Look first! There were cars in the street.
questions.explanation: Anna说考官让她转弯，John回应Look first，并说明街上有车，所以本题选先观察街上的车辆。talk to herself是她紧张时的习惯，加踩油门反而是John此前让她停止的动作。这里只理解对话中的纠正内容。

spokenEvidence.quote: Look first! There were cars in the street.

questions.prompt: According to John, why were other drivers honking?
options: Anna had already parked at the White House.
questions.explanation: Anna问为什么大家鸣喇叭，John直接回答You were driving too slow，因此是开得太慢。需要按这段问答核对，不能受前面差点碰车的情节影响就推断一定开得太快。白宫游览是后面的另一段经历。

questions.prompt: How do Anna and Marsha decide to continue toward the White House?
options: By driving right up to the building.
By returning the next day on a bus.
questions.evidence: I guess we walk from here!
questions.explanation: Marsha提醒不能直接开车靠近白宫后，Anna说从这里步行。结尾也再次说想看白宫需要走路。对话没有提到第二天改乘公交；“开车能多看城市”不等于任何目的地都能直接开到门前。

spokenEvidence.quote: I guess we walk from here!
